From frames 9-12 it keeps shrinking and two scribbled round wheels come up from the bottom edge, so the whole vehicle with a bottom line between the wheels is visible by frame 12. seen_film: A night shot of the back of an ambulance with a lit roof beacon, two rear windows (a patient on a stretcher in the left window, an attendant in the right), lettering and 'AMBULANCE' on the lower body, two tail lights, and later a lit licence plate. In frames 1-4 it fills most of the frame and is cut off at the bottom. Over frames 5-16 it drives away from the camera, shrinking steadily and staying centred, so its lower body and licence plate come into view by frames 10-12; parked cars line the right side and street lights dot the dark background. The shrinking slows in the last frames.
named_subject: An ambulance seen from behind (the doodle of a boxy van with a roof light, ray strokes and scribbled wheels).

primary_gap: In the later frames (e.png 17-25) the vehicle becomes narrower and taller than the doodle's squat, wide box, with the sides tapering in toward the bottom, so it reads less like the c.png van than the early frames do.
closes_when: In e.png 17-25 the body is about 1.7 times as wide as it is tall (like c.png), with near-vertical sides and the wheels set at the outer corners, while keeping the same overall size and centre as now.
protect: The steady centred recession that matches the film's timing frame for frame; the doodle's own marks (slanted roof line, crooked roof light with separate ray strokes, curved left and straight right centre lines, heavy multi-loop scribble wheels); the fixed grey scenery of parked cars and lights; no doubling or popping between frames.
